summary.text: Jay Xiong is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 67B who has served since January 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Jay Xiong defeated Fred Turk in the 2018 general election for District 67B and assumed office on January 8, 2019, and he defeated Turk again in 2020 and 2022.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Legacy Finance, House Capital Investment, and Labor, Industry, Veterans and Military Affairs Finance and Policy (Co-Chair) committees.
No Republican candidate is listed for the November 3, 2026 general election for the seat.
